sites.name: Taj Mahal
sites.description: A symbol of eternal love and a masterpiece of Mughal architecture in India.

sites.name: Great Wall of China
sites.description: An ancient series of walls and fortifications built to protect Chinese states from invasions.

sites.name: Machu Picchu
sites.description: A 15th-century Inca citadel located in the Andes Mountains of Peru.

sites.name: Colosseum
sites.description: A historic amphitheater in Rome known for gladiator contests and Roman architecture.

sites.name: Pyramids of Giza
sites.description: Ancient pyramid structures in Egypt and one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

sites.name: Acropolis of Athens
sites.description: An ancient citadel on a rocky outcrop above Athens with temples like the Parthenon.

sites.name: Petra
sites.description: A historical and archaeological city in southern Jordan carved into rose-red rock.

sites.name: Stonehenge
sites.description: A prehistoric monument in England made of standing stones aligned with the sun.

sites.name: Statue of Liberty
sites.description: A symbol of freedom and democracy located on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.

sites.name: Angkor Wat
sites.description: A massive temple complex in Cambodia and the largest religious monument in the world.
